easyPrerequisites:
There are at least two cards in your library.
There are two or more loyalty counters on Will Kenrith.
Woodwork Prodigy is prepared.
description:
Activate Will Kenrith's ability by removing two loyalty counters, drawing two cards and reducing the cost of the noted spell types by {2} until end of turn.
Cast the prepared copy of Soul Tether by paying {R/G} through the reduction from Will Kenrith.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Biblioplex Tomekeeper.
When Biblioplex Tomekeeper enters, it triggers, re-preparing Woodwork Prodigy.
Resolve the copy of Soul Tether, creating a Heartwood token.
Activate the Heartwood token by tapping it, adding {R} or {G}.
Repeat.
